notes: Make music on 8 GB cards: everything stays on the graphics card (nothing pushed into the computer's memory, which Windows needs) - the music model in 8 bits, one model on the card at a time; two 30-second takes with words in 42 seconds on an 8 GB card. The large model (Best) is offered with a 12 GB card and 32 GB of memory, and the page says why when it is not.
